name: Idi Amin
summary: Army officer who seized power in Uganda in a 1971 coup and ruled as military head of state until 1979. His government expelled most of the country's Asian population in 1972 and transferred their businesses and property to supporters, ran a state security service that tortured and killed suspected opponents, and governed by decree and a military council. He praised Hitler, attacked Israel, and in 1975 called for Israel's expulsion from the UN.
